flags.message: The docket snapshot (2026-10-29.json) lists two cert reply briefs filed by Petitioner: one on Aug 31, 2026 (replying to Irigoyen Farms' response) and a second on Oct 20, 2026 (replying to Walmart's Oct 13 post-CFR response). While brief-in-opposition.txt concatenated both respondents' briefs, cert-reply.txt only provisioned the Aug 31, 2026 reply and omitted the Oct 20, 2026 reply.
